# Vietnam Cleanroom (VCR)

> Vietnam Cleanroom is a GMP-compliant cleanroom equipment supplier and LENGE distributor providing filtration systems, contamination control products, and pharmaceutical manufacturing equipment for contractors and industrial facilities.

VCR specializes in cleanroom equipment and supplies for pharmaceutical and industrial applications, with a focus on GMP compliance and ISO 14644 standards. The site offers comprehensive product catalogs in Vietnamese and English, along with technical knowledge resources.

## Key Topics

- GMP Compliance
- Cleanroom Equipment
- Filtration Systems
- Pleated Filters
- Filter Materials (PES, PTFE, PVDF, PP, Nylon)
- Filter Housings
- Contamination Control
- Cleanroom Doors
- HVAC Systems
- Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
- ISO 14644
- Vietnam Cleanroom (VCR)
- LENGE Distributor
- Cleanroom Furniture
- Industrial Filters

## Product Catalog & Overview

- [Vietnam Cleanroom Homepage](https://vietnamcleanroom.com): VCR main homepage - cleanroom equipment supplier for contractors
- [Vietnam Cleanroom Vietnamese Homepage](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/vi): VCR Vietnamese homepage - LENGE distributor, GMP-compliant products
- [Product Catalog](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/product/public-product): Complete VCR product catalog - filters, housings, capsule filters, and cleanroom equipment

## Filtration Systems & Components

- [Pleated Filter Cartridges](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/vi/product/loi-loc-giay-xep-pleated-filter-cartridge-75.chm): Pleated filter cartridges with PES, PP, PTFE, PVDF materials for liquid and gas filtration
- [Filter Cores & Pleated Filters](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/vi/product/loi-loc-76.chm): Filter cores and pleated filters for liquid and gas filtration applications
- [Filter Membranes](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/vi/product/mang-loc-giay-xep-77.chm): Filter membranes in PES, PTFE, PVDF, and PP materials for various filtration needs
- [Liquid Filter Bags](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/vi/product/tui-loc-chat-long-79.chm): Liquid filter bags - nylon, PP, and PE fabric filters for contamination control
- [Filter Housings](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/vi/product/housing-loc-78.chm): Filter housings for liquid, gas, bag, and inline filtration systems

## Cleanroom Infrastructure & Access Control

- [GMP Cleanroom Steel Doors](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/vi/product/cua-thep-phong-sach-39.chm): GMP-compliant cleanroom steel doors - inox 304 construction with automatic drop seal
- [Interlock/Airlock Door Locks](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/vi/product/khoa-lien-dong-11.chm): Interlock and airlock door locks for contamination control and access management
- [Cleanroom Furniture](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/vi/product/noi-that-phong-sach-60.chm): Cleanroom furniture - stainless steel cabinets, tables, sinks, and workstations

## Monitoring & Specialized Equipment

- [Pressure Differential Gauge](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/vi/product/dong-ho-chenh-ap-1.chm): Pressure differential gauge for cleanroom monitoring systems and environmental control
- [Cleanroom Phones & Intercom Systems](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/vi/product/dien-thoai-phong-sach-64.chm): Cleanroom phones and intercom systems - VCR YA series for communication
- [Miscellaneous Cleanroom Equipment](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/vi/product/thiet-bi-khac-45.chm): Miscellaneous cleanroom equipment - LAF units, clean benches, sterilization systems

## Pharmaceutical Manufacturing

- [Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Equipment](https://vietnamcleanroom.com/vi/product/thiet-bi-san-xuat-duoc-58.chm): GMP-compliant pharmaceutical manufacturing equipment and machinery for production lines
